corrected_code:
@router.post("/api/v1/tenants/schemas/{schema_name}/audit-logs/export")
async def export_tenant_audit_schema(
    schema_name: str,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    if current_user.tenant_schema != schema_name or not current_user.is_tenant_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Access to audit logs of specified schema denied")
    await db.execute(text(f'SET LOCAL search_path TO "{schema_name}"'))
    stmt = select(SecurityAuditLog).order_by(SecurityAuditLog.timestamp.desc()).limit(200)
    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    logs = res.scalars().all()
    return [{"id": l.id, "actor": l.actor_email, "event": l.action, "ip": l.ip_address} for l in logs]
